title: Lumen Observatory
text: The Lumen Observatory stands in Aster City. Its public archive records the annual blue-moon survey.

title: Cedar Alloy Notes
text: Cedar alloy is a lightweight synthetic material made from copper, cedar fiber, and glass powder.

title: River Nera Route
text: River Nera begins at Mount Ilex and flows south through the Fenward basin before reaching Lake Orin.

title: Mount Ilex Archive
text: The summit of Mount Ilex was mapped in 1884 by the cartographer Sora Vale, whose field notebook is held in Aster City.

title: Orchid Relay Network
text: The Orchid Relay Network places its eastern relay station beside Blue Marsh to carry weather messages.

title: Blue Marsh Stewardship
text: Blue Marsh is protected by steward Niko Rell, who maintains the nearby Orchid relay station.

title: Pale Comet Observation
text: The pale comet Vesper was first recorded above the Northwatch tower during the winter crossing.

title: Northwatch Tower
text: Northwatch tower was built by the architect Yara Quill on the western ridge of Bell Plain.

title: Mica Archive Catalogue
text: The Mica Archive stores the silver code in Vault Sable, a sealed room below its reading hall.

title: Vault Sable Register
text: Vault Sable is maintained by keeper Ivo Sen, who checks the silver code register each spring.

title: Harbor Bell Log
text: The old harbor bell was moved from West Pier to East Quay after the great tide.

title: East Quay Workshop
text: Engineer Mira Dax maintains the bell mechanism at East Quay and teaches apprentices there.

title: Juniper Array Record
text: The Juniper Array weather station operates on Ember Plain and sends readings at dawn.

title: Ember Plain Charter
text: Ember Plain was founded by the surveyor Tavi Moss after the northern road was completed.

title: Aster City Tram Map
text: The green tram connects Aster City market, the library, and the eastern gardens.

title: Fenward Bird List
text: Fenward basin is home to reed herons, dusk swallows, and the small copper tern.

title: Lake Orin Water Survey
text: Lake Orin has clear spring water and a shallow southern shore used by survey boats.

title: Bell Plain Almanac
text: Bell Plain has dry grasslands and a line of old boundary stones near Northwatch.

title: Blue Marsh Weather Sheet
text: Blue Marsh receives heavy rain in late autumn and is crossed by a wooden footbridge.

title: Cedar Workshop Guide
text: Small cedar workshops use hand presses and natural oil to finish sample boards.

title: Vesper Star Chart
text: Vesper is a pale object visible shortly before dawn when the northern clouds clear.

title: Mica Reading Room
text: The Mica Archive reading room opens on Tuesdays and keeps a catalogue of local codes.

title: Juniper Field Manual
text: The Juniper Array uses a brass rain gauge and a wind vane calibrated each month.

title: Orin Ferry Timetable
text: The ferry crosses Lake Orin twice each day when the southern wind is calm.
